action: In Sculpt Mode picks the Paint tool (Paint Soft Pressure), opens the colour wheel and starts painting colour attributes.
tool: Sculpt Mode / Paint (Paint Soft Pressure), Mix
reader_equivalent: project_paint or bpy color_attributes fill per object

action: Paints the tank top olive-yellow, arms/skin pale pink-beige and the hair purple, one object at a time.
reader_equivalent: project_paint per object: top ~#B5A84A, skin ~#E3CFC6, hair ~#B85CC8 (hex estimated)

action: Paints lips coral-pink and soft cheek blush with Paint Soft; iris painted purple.
tool: Sculpt Mode / Paint (Paint Soft Pressure, Paint Soft)
reader_equivalent: project_paint small radius at lips (~#E88A7A) and cheeks, low strength

action: Switches to a Grease Pencil object in Draw Mode, Surface placement, picks a pencil/ink brush from the brush library with black colour.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Pencil-Ink brush
why: draw eye lines on top of the sculpt
reader_equivalent: bpy: add grease pencil object, draw strokes projected on surface (no blender-live tool)

action: Adjusts the drawn upper-lid line with GP sculpt Grab and in GP Edit Mode.
tool: Grease Pencil Sculpt Mode / Grab; Edit Mode

action: Draws black iris rings and pupils on the eyeballs with the Ink Pen grease pencil brush.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Ink Pen
why: eye detail as lines, not geometry
reader_equivalent: bpy gpencil circle strokes on eyeball surface

action: Ink Pen strokes for lashes/eye outline; a Grease Pencil object (GPencil.001) carries a Mirror modifier with the head as mirror object.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Ink Pen + Mirror modifier
why: draw one eye, mirror the other

action: Draws lashes with Ink Pen on a grease pencil object that has an Opacity modifier.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Ink Pen + Opacity modifier

action: In Sculpt Mode use the Paint (Paint Soft) brush with a salmon/pink colour to paint the lips directly on the sculpt.
tool: Sculpt Mode / Paint brush (Paint Soft, colour attribute)
reader_equivalent: project_paint colour salmon on lips region; or bpy color attribute + sculpt paint

action: Switch to a Grease Pencil object in Draw Mode, Ink Pen brush, black, and draw line accents on the hair surface.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Ink Pen (Surface placement)
reader_equivalent: bpy: gpencil object + strokes projected on surface (no MCP tool)

action: With Grease Pencil Ink Pen draw lip lines, shoulder lines and small marks on the cheek; GP object has Opacity and Mirror modifiers.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Ink Pen; GP modifiers Opacity + Mirror
reader_equivalent: bpy: gpencil strokes + Opacity/Mirror GP modifiers

action: Adjust the Opacity Factor on a Grease Pencil object's Opacity modifier in Object Mode.
